sn_aia_version.instructions:
1. Fetch the details of the current HSE work order.
2. Read the work description and completion notes provided by the technician or inspector.
3. Review the available safety checklist information, including PPE verification, hazards identified, equipment isolation, and work area safety.
4. Review available evidence such as uploaded photos, GPS/location information, and other completion details.
5. Generate a concise and professional work completion summary using only the information available in the work order.
6. Include the work performed, safety checks completed, important observations, and available evidence or findings.
7. If any safety concern or incomplete safety information is present, clearly mention it in the summary.
8. Do not invent, assume, or add information that is not available in the work order.
9. Return the final summary as the AI Work Summary for the HSE work order.
